verdict.rationale: Jules can be assigned a reported bug straight from a GitHub issue via the "jules" label. It clones the repo into a VM, installs dependencies, modifies files, proposes a plan, and delivers a diff and PR. The API explicitly targets automating bug fixing. Hands-on users report usable PRs and successful fixes (one after feeding back an error message), though success is described as roughly 75% and limited on complex problems. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the diagnosis step (reproducing the bug or running tests to verify the fix), and consistent reliability on complex codebases given reports of timeouts, loops and weak output beyond simple problems.
